snippet.title: “AIR KOLAM KOK COKELAT BEGINI?!” Ditertawakan… Pas Panen, Semua Malah Datang Belajar! #manusiarandom

Beberapa minggu kemudian, lelenya tumbuh sehat dan hasil panennya bikin orang-orang yang dulu ngeledek malah datang belajar.

Kadang cara yang kelihatan aneh belum tentu salah. Bisa jadi justru itu cara yang lebih efisien.

Kalau lihat kolam bioflok kayak gini, kalian bakal yakin… atau ikut ngeledek juga? 😄

일본의 고구마 품종인 ‘베니하루카(紅はるか)’를 사용한 신메뉴인데요✨ 바삭한 파이 속에 달콤한 고구마 앙금과 발효버터 풍미의 필링을 가득 채운 것이 특징!

고구마의 진한 단맛과 버터의 짭조름하고 고소한 풍미가 어우러져 바삭바삭하게 먹을 수 있는 간식이었어요.

📍[젯테리아 ゼッテリア / ZETTERIA]
- 위치: 일본 전국 젯테리아 매장 (일부 제외)
- 판매기간: 2026년 9월 9일 ~ 10월 중순 예정 (재고 소진 시 종료)

Made with Beni Haruka, a Japanese sweet potato variety✨ The crispy pastry is filled with sweet potato paste and a rich filling flavored with fermented butter!

The natural sweetness of sweet potato pairs perfectly with the rich, slightly salty butter flavor, making it a deliciously crispy treat!

📍[ゼッテリア / ZETTERIA]
- Location: ZETTERIA stores across Japan (some locations excluded)
- Available: September 9 – Mid-October 2026 (while supplies last)
- Menu: Beni Haruka Sweet Potato Pie (¥260)

snippet.description:
Why do wisdom teeth cause so much trouble? 🦷 Meet Moe (the last big tooth in the row, grumpy) and Wiz (the wisdom tooth, late, eager and stuck).

The science in two lines: wisdom teeth come in last, and often there is no room left, so they get stuck. And if one comes out only halfway, the gum over it traps food and can get infected.

Do you still have yours? 👇
